infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PetLens uses the camera to record a short side-on walking clip. Only the picture is measured. This app does not record or analyze sound.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PetLens opens your video library so you can choose a walking clip to measure. The chosen clip is sent to the analysis server and then deleted. Other photos and videos stay on this phone.
